get_device_of_tensor: get the device ID of a PyTorch tensor, returning -1 for CPU tensors
create_range_vector: create a range vector of a given size on the specified CPU or CUDA device
flatten_and_batch_shift_indices: flatten and shift batch indices to correctly index into a flattened target tensor
batched_index_select_target: select embeddings from a batched sequence tensor using multi-dimensional index tensors
batched_span_select_embeddings: extract span embeddings and masks from a sequence tensor given start and end indices
